tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find Tanatasa products to buy for Singapore delivery: pantry, household, health, personal care and beauty, 100% authentic. Delivery is free anywhere in Singapore with no minimum spend, so prices shown are delivered prices. Searches by words, brand, category, purpose, skin type, ingredient, stock, pr

tools.name: search_products_batch
tools.description: Search for a whole shopping list in one call: up to 10 queries, each with the search_products filters (5 results each by default). Delivery is free anywhere in Singapore with no minimum spend, so prices shown are delivered prices. Then start_checkout with the chosen variant_ids.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Read one product in full: description, ingredients, usage, images, every variant with price, unit pricing, stock and estimated delivery date, plus offer_terms (free Singapore delivery, returns, authenticity). product accepts a product ID, product slug, variant slug or SKU.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Fastest way to buy: send the whole basket (items [{variant_id, quantity}]) and the buyer's details (name, email, phone, Singapore address) in one call. Creates the cart, quotes it and starts checkout; no account needed. Returns checkout_id, details_version, total, buyer_summary and, for guests, a pr

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Start a cart to build up step by step (or use start_checkout to buy in one call); no account needed. Pass items [{variant_id, quantity}] to fill it at once. Returns cart_id, version, a quote (prices, free delivery, total) and, for guests, a private guest_token: pass guest_token on every later call a

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Read a cart's items, codes, current version and whether a checkout has locked it. Use quote_cart for prices and totals.

tools.name: set_cart_item
tools.description: Add, change or remove one item in an existing cart. quantity is the total wanted (not an increment); 0 removes it. Send the cart's current version; the result has the new one and a fresh quote. If the version is stale, the error includes current_cart; if stock is short, it includes available_quantit

tools.name: quote_cart
tools.description: Price the cart now: current prices, discounts, stock, free Singapore delivery (shipping 0) and the delivered total in SGD cents, with buyer_summary to show the buyer. Stock is not reserved. coupon_code previews a coupon or a friend's referral code without saving it. With account_token, applies the c

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Lock the quoted cart for purchase. Send the quote's version, its total as expected_total, a new idempotency_key and details (the buyer's name, email, phone and Singapore address; collect them first). coupon_code applies a code. Returns checkout_id, details_version, buyer_summary and a review link, v

tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description: Read a checkout: saved contact and delivery details, details_version, total, status and the ways to finish (review link, payment link). These details and links are private to the buyer.

tools.name: set_checkout_details
tools.description: Save the buyer's contact and Singapore delivery details on a checkout. Send its current details_version; the result has the new one. Does not charge anything. Details can't change once payment preparation starts.

tools.name: prepare_payment
tools.description: Get the hosted Stripe payment link, only after the buyer approved buyer_summary (details and total): send buyer_confirmed=true, that details_version, that total and an idempotency_key (reuse it on retries, and to get a fresh link if an unpaid link expired). Creates an unpaid order; nothing is charge

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Check an order: payment and delivery status, items, tracking and any cancellation or return request. Works for orders this session or account connection placed (guest_token for guests) and, with account_token, any of the signed-in customer's orders. Once paid it includes referral: show the buyer ref

tools.name: sign_in
tools.description: Sign the customer in with a code from their email. 1) Send email: Tanatasa emails them a 6-digit code. 2) Send email and the code they read to you: returns a private account_token (24 hours, this session only). 3) Send only account_token: shows their referral code and cashback credit with expiry dat

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List the signed-in customer's paid orders, newest first, from the website or any assistant: status, total, items, tracking and change requests. Needs account_token from sign_in (or an account-linked connection). Follow next_page for older orders.

tools.name: request_order_change
tools.description: Ask Tanatasa to cancel a paid order that hasn't shipped (kind cancel) or to take back a shipped or delivered order (kind return), with the customer's reason. Staff review it and email the customer; nothing is refunded or changed until then. Repeating the call returns the open request. Unpaid orders

tools.name: checkout_session
tools.description: Shortcut from product feed items to a checkout: send feed item ids (tanatasa-variant-<id>) and quantities. Guests call create_cart first and pass its guest_token. Item names and prices you send are ignored; Tanatasa's catalogue is authoritative. Returns a checkout and review link; continue with set_

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "sign_in" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_checkout, get_order, sign_in, request_order_change · Private data: start_checkout, create_cart, get_checkout, set_checkout_details, sign_in · Public sink: start_checkout, create_cart, set_cart_item, create_checkout, set_checkout_details, prepare_payment, get_order, sign_in, request_order_change, checkout_session · Destructive: set_cart_item.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_checkout, get_order, sign_in, request_order_change · Private data: start_checkout, create_cart, get_checkout, set_checkout_details, sign_in · Public sink: start_checkout, create_cart, set_cart_item, create_checkout, set_checkout_details, prepare_payment, get_order, sign_in, request_order_change, checkout_session · Destructive: set_cart_item

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search public sellable variants by words, brand/category/purpose, skin type, ingredient, availability and price in SGD cents. Use variant_id when adding items; follow next_page for more results." → after: "Find Tanatasa products to buy for Singapore delivery: pantry, household, health, personal care and beauty, 100% authentic. Delivery is free anywhere in Singapore with no minimum spend, so prices shown are delivered prices. Searches by words, brand, category, purpose, skin type, ingredient, stock, pr"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
